Description: Customer Requests Service: Customer contacts the auto parts store (in-person, telephone, or online portal) and reports a defective, malfunctioning auto part.
Trigger: Customer discovers defect in recently purchased auto part
Inputs: Defective auto part details, customer problem description
Outputs: Service replacement ticket registered; initial claim recorded
Notes / Alternative Paths: Multi-channel entry point (in-store counter, phone, or online warranty portal).

Description: Customer Provides Purchase Details: Customer supplies store sales receipt, order number, or loyalty account details to enable transaction verification.
Trigger: Clerk or portal requests proof of purchase
Inputs: Physical receipt, order confirmation number, or account ID
Outputs: Purchase credentials submitted to store system

Description: Purchase & Policy Validation: Clerk/System queries transaction database to confirm order authenticity, purchase date, and eligibility within warranty return window.
Inputs: Order ID / Receipt, Sales Database, Warranty policy criteria
Notes / Alternative Paths: Alternative Flow A2 (Purchase Unverified): If receipt is missing or expired, replacement request is denied; customer informed of documentation requirements. Flow terminates.

Description: Store Verifies Defect Claim: Clerk performs physical examination of the returned part or reviews digital photos/video evidence against defect standards.
Inputs: Physical part or digital evidence, manufacturer defect inspection guidelines
Outputs: Inspection decision: Manufacturing Defect vs Signs of Misuse
Notes / Alternative Paths: Alternative Flow A3 (Signs of Misuse): If damage resulted from improper installation or user misuse, request is rejected; customer reminded of policy limitations. Flow terminates.

Description: System Checks Inventory: Inventory system executes real-time stock lookup to determine if identical or OEM-equivalent replacement part is currently in stock.
Inputs: Validated part SKU, local inventory database, central warehouse catalog
Outputs: Inventory availability: In Stock vs Out of Stock
Notes / Alternative Paths: Alternative Flow A1 (No Inventory Available): If out of stock, system offers: (1) Refund, (2) Store Credit, (3) Back-Order. Customer selects preferred option; clerk executes choice. Flow terminates.

Description: Replacement Part Issued: Clerk initiates replacement transaction in POS, retrieves new part from stock, and hands it over to customer while collecting defective item.
Inputs: New replacement part, exchange authorization, collected defective unit
Outputs: New part delivered to customer; defective unit quarantined for RMA
Notes / Alternative Paths: Basic flow fulfillment. Physical exchange of parts occurs at the service counter.

Description: Confirmation Provided: System logs completed exchange, decrements stock count, updates RMA records, and generates printed receipt or automated email confirmation.
Inputs: Completed transaction record, customer contact info / printer
Outputs: Printed replacement receipt or automated email confirmation
Notes / Alternative Paths: Process terminates successfully. Customer departs with verified replacement and proof of exchange.
